download_policy: Download public model artifacts from the exact Hugging Face Hub commit SHA; load only the locally cached Transformers checkpoint; no model is initialized from random weights.

inference_protocol.decision_rule: checkpoint argmax; published class labels normalized to benign=0 and injection=1
inference_protocol.weights_format: native Transformers safetensors where available; no ONNX, quantization, or exported runtime

models.training_provenance_note: Published PIGuard checkpoint; cite its model card/paper. Treat scores on PIGuard D1 as in-source validation, not an external test.

withdrawn_models.withdrawal_note: Withdrawn and physically removed on 2026-10-02; lacks paper+repo pairing (self-cited as @misc).
